init_distributed_training: initialize a PyTorch distributed training process group using NCCL backend with SLURM or manual rank and world size
create_warmup_cosine_lr_schedule: create a WarmupCosineSchedule learning rate scheduler that warms up then decays with a cosine curve for an optimizer
create_cosine_weight_decay_schedule: create a CosineWDSchedule that applies cosine annealing to the weight decay parameter of an optimizer over training steps
time_gpu_closure: time the GPU execution of a callable closure using CUDA events and return the result with elapsed milliseconds
apply_truncated_normal_init: apply truncated normal initialization to a PyTorch tensor with configurable mean, std, and lower and upper bounds
